fields.FIR_Description: During the night of 2025-02-22, around 21:50, a grey truck bearing registration number KL-07-YY-1055 belonging to the complainant was taken from Mullai Puram Parking Area in Thanjavur, according to the complaint recorded on 2025-02-22. Hemanth Murugan approached Thanjavur Town PS to report the matter and can be reached on 9000000301. Pandian Thangaraj (mobile 9000000427) was named as a possible person of interest. Madhan Kumar (9000000410) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. Potentially relevant material referenced includes CCTV footage and a vehicle observation. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00010, as the mobile number 9000000427 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Vehicle allegedly driven away from an industrial parking space at night.
fields.Keywords: truck theft, vehicle, night, vehicle observation, mobile number, CCTV, suspect, truck
